title: Raw Data Sanitizer & Deduplicator Pro
target_pain: Messy CSV, TSV, and JSON data containing duplicates, inconsistent casing, blank lines, and broken delimiters that break ingestion pipelines.
key_features: Instant client-side CSV, TSV & JSON parsing and cleaning
Smart duplicate row removal based on exact match or specific column keys
Automatic trim whitespace, lowercase/uppercase normalization, and null-value stripping
Real-time data stats (row count, column count, duplicate count removed)
Export cleaned data instantly to CSV, JSON, or Copy to Clipboard
